follow-up time: From 22nd to 25th week of gestation until delivery
cohort: 1500 pregnant women in São Luís, Brazil and 1500 pregnant women in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil
finding: The study aims to identify risk factors for preterm birth with greater predictive power than classically studied factors.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section in the absence of labor will be used as a marker of medical intervention.
gest_age: 22nd to 25th week of gestation at recruitment
